Entries.Original: Sorry to ask this of you after training, but I have a mission for 31-A.
See? What did I tell you?
This can't be! All my heartfelt gratitude, all my warm thanks—I want it all baaack!
Stop that. Do you want to set her off?
Nanase, please brief them on the details.
Yes, ma'am. Today, at 16:45, a Cancer swarm was spotted around the Ariake Dome.
Its leader was a single Cancer we are naming Medusa. Its current whereabouts are unknown, despite four squads being on active patrol.
Simply put, a Cancer appeared far too close to base.
Wait a sec. If all that really is true, then it's just weird that the front-line patrol squads didn't spot it.
Exactly. Given the unusual circumstances, we need to deploy your squad.
If our front line was breached, why are you so calm?
There are several reasons.
While it's true that the Medusa is a Cancer we have yet to encounter, and it matches none of our records...
Judging by its appearance and length, HQ has deemed its threat level marginal at best.
Given that you have already defeated a Death Slug, you are more than ready.
True... Cancer size usually correlates to Cancer strength...
Your mission is to locate this Medusa, defeat it, and discover how it managed to slip through our patrol.
However, Operation Pleiades is equally important, so do not allow this to interfere with your training.
Aw c'mooon! Just choose one or the other!
It's poor timing, I'm aware. Normally, we would bolster our defenses and continue gathering intel, but we cannot afford to do so this close to Operation Pleiades.
Why not?
It's simple. We lack the numbers.
What kinda flimsy excuse is that?
Should we reach the day of the operation without defeating it, we'll be forced to withdraw.
It is too much of a gamble to risk the dome being attacked while our defenses are spread thin.
On the other hand, taking squads off the operation and putting them on guard duty is also not an option.
The entire operation would fall through.
Yes. As such, HQ has determined that the Medusa poses a high risk to both the operation and the dome dwellers and issued a special patrol mission as a result.
Search the designated area as quickly as possible and eliminate the enemy.
You have four days including today to complete this objective. Leave now and link up with the patrol.
This is a heavy responsibility, and it is your first mission from headquarters as an assault squad. Do not disappoint.
Aw, maaan...
Just say "understood," dum-dum.
Understood, dum-dum!
WITHOUT the "dum-dum"!
